blocks.text: Binibining Pilipinas Sasha Lacuna’s trajectory at The Miss Globe pageant’s 2026 edition continues to rise as the competition nears the homestretch in Thailand. The college student from Tarlac is still leading the poll for “Miss Social Media” on the second day of voting for Round 2. She amassed the most votes at the end of Round 1, where the 10 ladies who moved on to the second round were determined. Lacuna was also among the 10 best performers at the recent swimsuit presentation held in Phuket on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Host delegate Nam Ing Suttida Aladpu from Thailand topped the competition. […]...
